description: This PHP class 'InAccessibleEmpNumbers' defines a validation rule within the OrangeHRM system for checking employee number accessibility based on user roles and authentication context. It determines whether an employee number is accessible or not depending on configuration and the current user's permissions.

classes.name: InAccessibleEmpNumbers
classes.description: A validation rule class to check if an employee number is accessible based on user roles and login status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule, optionally including the logged-in employee number in accessibility checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the provided employee number is accessible based on permissions and configuration.
